Game Overview

Fortress of the Wizard is a action title where unleash your magical prowess as a mighty wizard defending your fortress against relentless demons. Cast explosive fireballs, chilling ice blasts, and devastating meteors in a spellbinding battle of strategy and survival. Explore diverse realms, discovering potent power-ups that fortify your defenses against unique foes. Can you protect your fortress?
